noticePopup.title: Aap Ki Support Bohot Zaroori Hai
noticePopup.html:
Assalamualaikum,

Extension sab ke liye 100% free hai — aap sab araam se use kar rahe hain ❤️

Mujhe aap sab ki support ki bohot zaroorat hai.

Is extension ko chalaye rakhne, update karne aur behtar banane ke liye thori si madad chahiye — koi paisa nahi, sirf aapka chhota sa waqt.

  • 28 August se chota unlock step shuru hoga
  • Sirf 20–30 second ka 1 task → 6 ghante free unlock
  • Extension free rahegi — koi charges nahi

Guide video dekhein — unlock ka tareeqa step by step samjh aa jayega.
Apni duaon mein yaad rakhiye. JazakAllah Khair 🌸
